name: Hydraulic Press's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: Capturing with a Rook on an adjacent tile skips the enemy's turn.
description: An epic gambit for close-quarters Rooks: capture a piece that sits one tile away orthogonally and the enemy's next turn is skipped. The counterpart to Sniper's Gambit, which rewards long-range Bishop captures instead. Needs the Gambit Creation API and the 'Point A' Manager library, both of which install automatically.
